description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm' and related classes that are responsible for rendering configuration forms for the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for generating HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fragments, and handles form element creation, namespace rendering, and input type rendering for configuration directives.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm
classes.description: Handles rendering of configuration forms for HTMLPurifier settings, including structuring HTML for directive and value inputs, and namespace management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_NullDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class adding a null/disable option to other configuration input printers.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_default
classes.description: Renders default input fields, such as textareas, for directives.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_bool
classes.description: Renders boolean (Yes/No) radio button inputs for directives.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the form with name, documentation URL, and compression settings.

methods.name: setTextareaDimensions
methods.description: Sets default size for textarea elements in the form.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Returns the CSS styling for the form as a string.

methods.name: getJavaScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code needed for form interactions.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML for the configuration form based on current config state.

methods.name: renderNamespace
methods.description: Renders a section of directives within a namespace, including labels and input fields.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render method in various classes, creates input elements for specific directive types.
